name: ondimi-weddings
description: Run your wedding's guest communication from ChatGPT: import your guest list, collect RSVPs and mailing addresses, answer guest questions, and send updates you approve, through onDimi's AI guest concierge.

interface.longDescription:
onDimi Weddings connects ChatGPT to your wedding on onDimi, an AI guest concierge that texts, emails, calls and chats with every guest party for you.

Ask how RSVPs are going and get exact numbers and names. Paste your guest list from a spreadsheet or a wedding-website export and ChatGPT imports it, fills in existing guests instead of duplicating them, and shows what changed. Start the RSVP or mailing-address campaign for the guests you choose; onDimi follows up on its own and stops when a guest answers. When something changes, like a new ceremony time or the shuttle schedule, ChatGPT drafts one update, shows you a sample, and sends it only to the guests you approve. Keep the details the concierge uses to answer guests current.

You stay in control. The connection sees only your wedding, reading never changes anything, and nothing reaches a guest until you approve it.

New to onDimi? Create your wedding in the sign-in window. It doesn't contact anyone until you're ready.
defaultPrompt: Help us set up our wedding details.
Send an update to our guests.

positive.expected_behavior: Connected to Chris & Macy Wedding (ChatGPT Reviewer). Reports 98 guests: 76 attending, 14 declined and 8 awaiting a response (90 of 98 responded), with the November 14 RSVP deadline. Changes nothing.

Lists the 14 declined guests by party: Ivy Griffin; Owen and Kate Russell; Derek Bryant; Julian and Maria Rivera; Audrey and Miles Long; Gabriel and Tara Perry; Ethan and Molly Brooks; Noah and Grace Kim. Changes nothing.

positive.prompt: Add a guest: Alex Rivera, phone 555-555-0199.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds Alex Rivera with phone 555-555-0199 as a new guest party and confirms it. No message is sent to the guest.

positive.description: Drafts a guest update without sending
positive.prompt: Draft an update telling our attending guests the ceremony now starts at 4:30 PM, and show me a sample.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a draft and shows a one-guest sample, e.g. "Hi Ryan, it's Chris & Macy here. The ceremony now starts at 4:30 PM. We look forward to celebrating with you! Reply STOP to opt out.", and states that nothing has been sent. Sending requires a separate approval.

positive.description: Updates the information the concierge uses
positive.prompt: Add to our venue information: shuttles leave the hotel lobby at 3:45 PM and return at 11 PM.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the shuttle times (leave the hotel lobby 3:45 PM, return 11 PM) to the wedding's venue information and confirms the update. Guests are not contacted.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: onDimi is not used; the request has nothing to do with the user's wedding guests.

negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a string.
negative.expected_behavior: onDimi is not used; the request has nothing to do with the user's wedding guests.

negative.prompt: Book us a honeymoon flight to Cancun.
negative.expected_behavior: onDimi is not used: it manages guest communication, not travel booking.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: the onDimi Weddings MCP server (guest list, RSVPs, addresses, guest updates and the wedding information the concierge uses) and seven wedding skills.
